description:
Job: Full Stack Java Developer 
 Location: Washington DC 
 Duration: 6 Months 
 Need GC and USC 
 
 The purpose of this position is to provide support for critical business functions through the development, implementation, testing and maintenance of enterprise-wide applications systems in an Agile environment. 
 
 SKILLS: 
 Front End: JQuery 3+, JSP, JSF and JavaScript 
 Middle Tier: Java 1.7+ 
 Back-end: Spring 4.3+ (Need Spring MVC), (Good to have: Spring Security, SpringREST) 
 Back-end framework: Hibernate 5.0+ (Hibernate-Spatial Experience Preferred) 
 Back-end database: PostGreSQL 9+ (PostGIS experience is required) 
 Application Sever: Jboss (required), Tomcat (Good to have) 
 WebServices: RESTful JAXRS, SpringREST, Jersey required 
 Atlasian GIT source code repository is required 
 Bamboo for CI a plus
 RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 Design, code, test, debug, maintain, and document software applications 
 Follow established software development standards and procedures 
 Support business functions through the development, implementation, and maintenance of applications systems 
 Participate in peer code reviews 
 Work with complex application features and technical designs 
 Collaborate with departments and users in the support of business applications 
 Contribute software development expertise to multiple projects and ensure that specifications are met 


 If you are interested in the below position please forward your profile to preethib@usmsystems(dot)com or call me on 703 468 0398.
